name: Herbed Corn
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 7 ears sweet corn, husks and silks carefully removed

steps: Combine all ingredients except corn in small bowl. Mix well.
Measure about 1 tbsp of the mixture and spread over each ear of corn.
Wrap each ear of corn in heavy foil.
Grill over medium heat 10–15 minutes, or until tender.
